messages:
Maya C: hey team — quick recon before ACME's renewal next week. I pulled the SLA report for the last 90 days and there are a few things to align on: uptime is 99.62% vs contracted 99.9%, p95 latency for inference routes avg ~420ms (contract 300ms), and onboarding checklist shows only 7/10 enablement milestones completed. we need a proposal for comms + credit calc and an enablement plan. can eng confirm root cause of latency drift? :thinking_face:
Liam K: saw the alert — looks like a burst of long-tail traffic after the new feature rollout on 3/12. KV cache hit rate dropped ~15% for that tenant. investigating whether model variant fallback increased token cost/latency.
Aria P: thanks @Liam — can you paste the KV/cache metrics and the model routing log snippet here? Nina + I need numbers to calculate possible SLO credit exposure.
Liam K: putting snippets, fyi logs filtered:
```
2026-03-10T14:02:12Z route=eu-west model=redwood-v1 variant=quantized fallback=true kv_hit=0.73 req_ms=430
2026-03-12T02:14:05Z route=eu-west model=redwood-v1 kv_hit=0.58 req_ms=512
```
these correspond to the 3/12 spike. looks like fallback to a larger model variant during autoscaling pressure.
Nina R: for renewal risk math: if we hit credit threshold (monthly uptime below 99.8) they are eligible for prorated credits. need exact downtime window and affected calls. Maya can you confirm the customer-visible incidents we reported?
Maya C: we opened two incident tickets (INC-8312, INC-8330) and notified ACME on 3/12 and 3/13. they asked about impact to throughput for their batch sync jobs.
Aria P: action items I suggest:
- eng: produce a short root-cause note + KV hit & routing stats by day (Liam)
- cs: compile customer-facing evidence bundle, include incident IDs and sample logs (Maya)
- renewals: draft credit estimate and remediation commitment for renewal pack (Nina)
- enablement: finish 3 remaining onboarding items and offer a 1:1 ops call next week (Maya / Aria)
can we aim EOD tomorrow for initial drafts?
Liam K: can do. I'll add a short blameless RCA and point to the autoscaler logs. expect a dump by 11:00 PT tomorrow.
Maya C: I'll assemble evidence bundle and a one-page service summary for ACME. will also include recommended interim mitigations (prefix caching, route pinning).
Nina R: I'll run a quick credit calc template once I have uptime windows. tentative credit range 1-3% of monthly invoice, final after eng confirmation. I'll seed the renewal pack with a mitigations timeline to reduce churn risk.
DevOps Bot: incident INC-8312 updated by @Liam K — root cause analysis attached. https://incidents.redwood/internal/INC-8312
Aria P: thanks everyone. next sync: Monday 10am PT with Maya, Liam, Nina, and ACME success contact. Maya — can you book the call and include the one-pager and credit estimate draft in the invite?
Maya C: booking now. invite will have `ACME renewal health + SLO reconciliation` and link to the evidence bundle. ping me if any blockers. :thumbsup:
